title: Resolve RCM owner scope before combining Difco identity with Oxoid CM0149 provenance
body:
The final campaign intake contains two individually source-bound proposals for the same authentic `data/ingredients/unmapped/Reinforced_Clostridial_Medium.yaml` beforeimage (`7f94183c0d9b070b57c1ffa8beab53817b48791a75278957163619ece7a24c2e`). They cannot be combined as a compatible delta union.

The baseline is UNMAPPED_0507, a named medium originally imported from MediaDive ingredient1769. Later history explicitly added BD-Difco and two Oxoid aliases to this one owner. The record currently contains no component formula. Its history and both origin scopes must survive reconciliation.

- W03 `b-proposal-cm0149-form`, head `1196d5bc3aaba7563b829d5cbe7e54722fccc35d`, payload `137dd17759a3ed4d80255d3869611c81233c57c5ca61b58b0ff8fad82d71c328`, adds the Oxoid CM0149 supplied form while retaining UNMAPPED and an explicit mixed-owner partition requirement. Case `CM_NAME:2be5d4f231ea346e62be345a8e8b35adbc735ccdced2de73963ce5265c48fd66`, occurrence `CM_OCC:ffcf2b54ee7027b6166807e15a6a72a9bae955a7c8c4576805c5bb8e99196307`, CultureMech:008256, TOGO M1696/NBRC902.
- W05 `M1193-P-RCM-182`, head `43f7cf6e8681fa617b5d6d3529d94d537ca01f0d`, payload `21ae9f818beef065d14b1562cf7d968dc8441a7edc6dd3c7ea7e7e87d2d26b30`, proposes the BD-Difco product identity `kgmicrobe.ingredient:reinforced_clostridial_medium_difco`, its nine-part formula, and rejection of the two Oxoid aliases for that selected product. Case `KG_CASE:deb11ac97bd19cd33a5b09abfc21a6f25108c238ab3ae43b7037b520466325bd`, MediaDive ingredient1769.

The primary evidence establishes an actual product/formulation distinction:

- [NBRC902](https://www.nite.go.jp/nbrc/catalogue/NBRCMediumDetailServlet?NO=902) specifies CM0149 Broth (OXOID), 38g, with water and optional additional agar. Its exact brand is not BD-Difco.
- [Current Oxoid IFU0539](https://assets.thermofisher.com/TFS-Assets/MBD/Instructions/MBD_BT_IFU-0539%20CM0149B%20REINFORCED%20CLOSTRIDIAL%20MEDIUM.pdf), page1 CM0149B/T table, lists yeast extract13g/L and no beef extract, with agar0.5g/L. The separate CM0151 agar table must not be substituted.
- [Manufacturer Difco/BBL manual, RCM section](https://cdn.media.interlabdist.com.br/uploads/2021/01/Reinforced-Clostridial-Medium.pdf), page1, lists peptone10g/L, beef extract10g/L, yeast extract3g/L and agar0.5g/L. The printed peptone is not a proven named historical Tryptose subproduct.
- [MediaDive1769](https://mediadive.dsmz.de/ingredients/1769) records three BD-Difco uses, supporting the original owner’s source continuity but not erasing later Oxoid source claims. [DSMZ634](https://www.dsmz.de/microorganisms/medium/pdf/DSMZ_Medium634.pdf) permits multiple suppliers; permission to use alternatives is not whole-product identity evidence.

Do not append the W03 Oxoid supplied form under a Difco-specific identity or assign the Difco formula to the Oxoid occurrence. Conversely, do not discard the supported Difco source case merely to keep one generic owner. Manufacturer-version differences cannot be backdated without evidence.

Bounded resolution requires an explicit whole-owner/source partition decision under MAPPING_SEMANTICS §3/§6, including: retain a generic unresolved named-medium owner plus separately deduplicated product identities, or preserve the original MediaDive1769 continuity on the Difco owner and separately represent the Oxoid scope, with explicit handling of every prior alias/source occurrence. These are options, not an implemented owner split or an identifier selection. Check existing records before creating anything. Keep authentic beforeimage, every origin history and source-case backlink; reject incorrect aliases only for the scope that makes them false, not as rejection of genuine source observations.

Acceptance: source/brand/version-bounded records, explicit identity lineage, reviewed memberships and any necessary dependent references, native writer/schema/partonomy/SSSOM gates, and independent review of the final full owner payloads. No automatic worker/hash-order winner, inferred product equivalence, role approval or lost case. TARGET-032 remains blocked; other groups can proceed independently.

Local exact evidence and copied primary captures: `.temp/all-unmatched-20261107/integration/final-same-target-reconciliation-v1/finding-rcm-v1/`. Live deduplication checked all 1,223 visible issue/PR bodies across 13 complete REST pages, three indexed searches and complete comments on #1193/#1196/#1212. No existing RCM/CM0149 formulation-partition issue was found in those checks; arbitrary comments outside indexed/direct reads were not exhaustively downloaded. No RCM successor has been written or applied.
